problems.problem: Bottle appears to float above the floor due to a detached contact shadow (offset_y=0 but shadow is visually separated from the bottle base, lacking realistic contact cues). Visible gap between bottle base and floor surface, with shadow not conforming to the floor's texture.

Unbalanced layout: product occupies 59% of canvas height (within 50-65% range) but is left-aligned, creating negative space on the right. Typography (title/subtitle) is clustered on the right, disrupting visual flow and reducing hierarchy.

Generic sans-serif font (Arial) lacks luxury refinement. Title/subtitle color (#FAE4D5) contrasts poorly with the dark background, reducing readability and failing to match the sophisticated tone of reference campaigns.

Background lacks the dramatic, concept-driven storytelling of references (e.g., Tom Ford's fig imagery, Byredo's abstract red form). The current background is a generic studio setup, not a cohesive visual narrative.

changes.value: Deep wine-red painted plaster wall with a single strong diagonal shadow cast across it from a high window, continuous matte red floor with subtle texture, smooth clean center and lower foreground, realistic physical studio environment photograph
